title: 휴대폰 설정 화면 읽기: 켜졌어요? 꺼졌어요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean Settings screen, tell whether a function is on (켜짐) or off (꺼짐), and choose the right menu for a simple everyday problem.
summary: Learners read a Korean phone Settings screen and find menu names, on/off status, and numbers such as battery level.
note: This Settings screen is a simplified example; menu names on your own phone may look a little different.

task.title: Read and choose settings
task.line: Read each screen or sentence and answer with the menu word, on/off word, or number you learned.

sections.heading: Sample screen: 설정
paragraphs: 설정  |  Wi-Fi: 켜짐 (두루카페)  |  블루투스: 꺼짐  |  소리: 켜짐  |  밝기: 70%  |  알림: 켜짐  |  배터리: 15%  |  언어: 한국어
Left side: the menu name. Right side: how it is set now. On this phone, Wi-Fi is on, Bluetooth is off, and the battery is low (15%).

sections.heading: Menu words on the Settings screen

items.text: The app where you change how your phone works.
Connects your phone to the internet without using mobile data.
Connects your phone to earphones, speakers, or a car.
Turns ringtones and other sounds on or off.
Makes the screen lighter or darker.
Makes the letters on the screen bigger or smaller.
Controls the messages that pop up from apps.
Shows how much power is left, in %.
Changes the language of the phone menus.
The secret number or word for Wi-Fi or for opening your phone.

sections.heading: Reading tip: on or off?
paragraphs: 켜짐 = on, 꺼짐 = off. Buttons often say 켜기 (turn on) and 끄기 (turn off). In a sentence: 켜요 / 꺼요.
A number with % is usually the battery or the brightness. Wi-Fi is often written in English, but you read it 와이파이.

exercises: Look at the screen and answer: [설정] Wi-Fi 꺼짐 | 블루투스 켜짐 | 배터리 42% ① Is Wi-Fi on? (Yes/No) ② Is Bluetooth on? (Yes/No) ③ How much battery is left?
Which menu do you open? Choose from 소리, 밝기, 언어: ① 화면이 너무 어두워요. 잘 안 보여요. ② 영화관이에요. 조용히 해야 해요. ③ 한국어를 잘 몰라요. 영어로 보고 싶어요.
Fill in the blank with 켜짐 or 꺼짐: ① 블루투스를 껐어요. 화면에 '____'이 보여요. ② 와이파이를 켰어요. 화면에 '____'이 보여요.
Put the steps in order to connect to Wi-Fi: (가) 비밀번호 입력 (나) 설정 열기 (다) 연결됨 (라) Wi-Fi 켜기
Fill in the blank with one word from the list (알림, 비밀번호, 글자 크기): ① 친구 집 와이파이에 연결하고 싶어요. 친구에게 ____를 물어봐요. ② 글씨가 너무 작아요. 설정에서 ____를 바꿔요.
answers: ① No (꺼짐 = off) ② Yes (켜짐 = on) ③ 42%
① 밝기 ② 소리 ③ 언어
